A '''green-bladed''' '''lightsaber''' was used by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] before it got destroyed during a mission with his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Xanatos]]. He later constructed [[Qui-Gon Jinn's lightsaber/Legends|another one]] to replace it.<ref name="JTDS 5" />

==Behind the scenes==
Qui-Gon Jinn's first lightsaber first appeared in the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[Jedi — The Dark Side 1|Jedi—The Dark Side 1]],<ref name="JTDS 1" /> published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[May 18]], [[2011]]. The comic was written by [[Scott Allie]] and illustrated by [[Mahmud Asrar]].<ref name="MTV">{{WebCite|url=http://splashpage.mtv.com/2011/01/27/star-wars-jedi-the-dark-side-comic-preview-scott-allie|text=Announcement|work=MTV.com|archivedate=20110128171502}}</ref>
